name: TacticsVanguard2D
description: Turn-based tactics sample on a 15x17 field of 16-px tiles: masked 16x26 unit sprites (vxpe2d_blit), Dijkstra move range with a hatched field and path arrow, parchment action card, skewed cut-in band with 3x scaled portraits, terrain-driven combat math, pathing AI, plus splash, army-select menu and briefing screens.
